name: Andrew
overview: Andrew, a fisherman from Bethsaida, is introduced in Scripture as the brother of Simon Peter, both called by Jesus while casting their nets into the sea of Galilee. Jesus invites them to follow Him, promising to make them fishers of men, highlighting Andrew's initial response to Christ’s call. He is consistently recognized among the twelve apostles, with his name appearing prominently alongside Peter's. The Gospel accounts also depict Andrew's close association with Jesus and other disciples, including moments where he hosts Jesus in his home, underscoring his integral role in the early ministry.
